turns.text: You get tipped if you give some exceptional service… Even then… Even then you feel like… okay.
turns.zh: 如果你提供了特别出色的服务，才会拿到小费……就算那样……就算那样你也觉得……好吧。

turns.text: But what what is exceptional service?
turns.zh: 但什么才算特别出色的服务呢？

turns.text: I would say if there's a big group of you, if there's like, more than eight and they've been on time and everything's come and they've made sure that everyone's got what they need, because that's hard because I've been a waiter and it's really hard to have a big table, so I think if you have a big table
turns.zh: 我觉得如果你们是一大群人，比如超过八个人，而且他们准时到了，菜都上齐了，还确保每个人都拿到了自己需要的东西，因为那很难，因为我当过服务员，应付一大桌真的很难，所以我觉得如果是一大桌

turns.text: it's kind of courteous to give a tip but I went to The States recently and it's mental, I went to a buffet and it was a, it's a buffet!
turns.zh: 给点小费算是挺有礼貌的，但我最近去了美国，那简直疯了，我去了一家自助餐，那是个，那是自助餐啊！

turns.text: The concept of a buffet is you serve yourself.
turns.zh: 自助餐的概念就是你自己服务自己。

turns.text: Oh you had to tip in a buffet?
I had to tip the person who literally took my card at the till.
turns.zh: 我得给那个在收银台 literally 接过我卡的人小费。
